//: Standalone strict TypeScript config for this extracted Cinatra extension repo. Extends nothing — the package compiles on its own, and its own CI typechecks it. No dist emit: the display entry is consumed as SOURCE by the host bundler, and `main`/`types` already point at source.
//host-provided: The SDK is HOST-PROVIDED: the host resolves it when it builds this package, and a standalone extension repository cannot resolve it at all. Each path below therefore resolves its specifier to the real SDK source when one is installed at that path, and to a signature-only declaration in ./types otherwise. An installed SDK wins where it still publishes that source path; if it moved the file, this repository would typecheck against the local shape instead, so the AUTHORITATIVE typecheck against the real SDK is the one that runs where the SDK lives.
